brief: Distinguish a minimum required payment from paying off the balance, and calculate the remaining debt under explicitly stated charges.

en-US.scenario: Fictional US-dollar examples for "Minimum is not interest-free"; illustrative amounts, not current prices or product offers. No assumption of salary, bank ownership or spare income.

es-MX.scenario: Ejemplos ficticios en pesos mexicanos para "El mínimo no elimina intereses"; montos ilustrativos, no precios vigentes ni ofertas. No se supone nómina, cuenta bancaria ni dinero sobrante.

pt-BR.scenario: Exemplos fictícios em reais para "O mínimo não elimina juros"; valores ilustrativos, não preços atuais nem ofertas. Sem supor salário, conta bancária ou dinheiro sobrando.

objective.observable_action: Distinguish a minimum required payment from paying off the balance, and calculate the remaining debt under explicitly stated charges.
objective.success_criterion: Complete the fresh-context transfer using only its visible information.

instruction.relevance: The minimum payment is the smallest amount the agreement requires. It does not automatically clear the balance or eliminate interest.
instruction.misconception: Believing that making the minimum automatically erases interest or clears the debt.
instruction.numeracy_support: Apply the earlier debt-update rule: starting debt plus stated charge minus payment; examples have no unstated fees or new purchases.

evidence.reasoning: This fictional statement starts at 100, adds interest of 10 and requires at least 20. Paying 20 leaves 90 owed.
Meeting the required minimum and clearing the full debt are different. Check the remaining balance and the stated interest conditions.
The minimum payment does not erase the separately stated interest charge.
Meeting the floor does not prove that no debt or interest remains.
Under the same charges, the larger payment reduces more debt.
The payment covers the charge without reducing the original debt.
The minimum amount alone does not establish interest treatment.
The larger payment still leaves debt after the stated charge is included.
I checked the statement: debt and interest remain. Meeting the minimum does not remove them.

delayed_retrieval.fresh_context: Apply this skill in a later integrated decision with a different constraint.

pt-BR.line: O pagamento mínimo é o menor valor exigido pelo acordo. Não quita automaticamente o saldo nem elimina os juros.

pt-BR.prompt: Leia o que significa o mínimo
pt-BR.line: Este extrato fictício começa em 100, soma 10 de juros e exige pelo menos 20. Pagar 20 deixa 90 de dívida.

en-US.setup: I paid the minimum on time.
en-US.recovery: I checked the statement: debt and interest remain. Meeting the minimum does not remove them.

en-US.line: Meeting the required minimum and clearing the full debt are different. Check the remaining balance and the stated interest conditions.

es-MX.line: Cumplir el mínimo y liquidar toda la deuda son cosas distintas. Revisa el saldo restante y las condiciones de interés.

pt-BR.line: Cumprir o mínimo e quitar toda a dívida são coisas diferentes. Confira o saldo restante e as condições de juros.

en-US.scene: Starting debt is 100; interest adds 10; the minimum payment of 20 is paid. No other changes occur.
help: Include the charge before subtracting the payment.

feedback.met: The minimum payment does not erase the separately stated interest charge.
feedback.not_yet: Include the charge before subtracting the payment.

choice_hints.option-1: This subtracts the payment but omits the added interest.
choice_hints.option-2: Update debt with the charge, then subtract the payment.
choice_hints.option-3: A minimum payment does not automatically clear all debt.

es-MX.scene: La deuda inicia en 100; se añaden 10 de interés y se paga el mínimo de 20. No hay otros cambios.
help: Incluye el cargo antes de restar el pago.

feedback.met: El pago mínimo no elimina el cargo de interés indicado.
feedback.not_yet: Incluye el cargo antes de restar el pago.

choice_hints.option-1: Esto resta el pago, pero omite el interés añadido.
choice_hints.option-2: Actualiza la deuda con el cargo y resta el pago.
choice_hints.option-3: El pago mínimo no liquida automáticamente toda la deuda.

pt-BR.scene: A dívida começa em 100; somam-se 10 de juros e paga-se o mínimo de 20. Não há outras mudanças.
help: Inclua a cobrança antes de subtrair o pagamento.

feedback.met: O pagamento mínimo não elimina a cobrança de juros informada.
feedback.not_yet: Inclua a cobrança antes de subtrair o pagamento.

choice_hints.option-1: Isso subtrai o pagamento, mas omite os juros adicionados.
choice_hints.option-2: Atualize a dívida com a cobrança e subtraia o pagamento.
choice_hints.option-3: O pagamento mínimo não quita automaticamente toda a dívida.

feedback.not_yet: Answer only what the payment and stated terms establish.

en-US.prompt: Which payment leaves less debt in this example?

help: Keep the starting debt and charges equal when comparing payments.

feedback.met: Under the same charges, the larger payment reduces more debt.
feedback.not_yet: Keep the starting debt and charges equal when comparing payments.
